rationale: The lowest zero-crossing rate over speech frames of any window (900 crossings per second against 1000-1050 elsewhere), i.e. the darkest and slowest-sounding speech in the set. A crude speaking-rate proxy, and labelled as one.
annotator_notes: Confirm the speaker count. `speakers` is currently unknown and its provenance is `unverified`.
Confirm the language mix. Nothing in the harness can hear a language.
Mark any stretch where two people talk over each other. Acoustic energy cannot detect overlap, and the DER a diarizer can reach is bounded by it.
Note any word the recogniser is likely to mangle: product names, API names, romanised Hindi spelled two ways.
If you write reference.words.json, time the words to the nearest 10 ms and say so in ANNOTATED.md.
